After his parents die, Clay struggles to balance school, work, and raising his sister. Bullies later help him graduate after learning his truth, proving you never know what someone is going through.

programmes.t: Poor Kid Wins Race With Old Broken Shoes
programmes.d: Lucky, a poor Punjabi boy, and his sister share one pair of shoes. He enters a race to win her new ones but loses to help a hurt runner. His selflessness leads to a life-changing reward for his family.

Carly pretends to be a helpless "girly girl" to win Lucas. He rejects her deceit, saying he misses the old her. Carly returns to her authentic self, and Lucas reveals he likes the real her, asking her to the dance.

programmes.t: Genius Kid Is Expelled From School
programmes.d: Underestimated due to autism, Jayden uses his engineering genius to save his school from a major crisis. His mother's "white lie" about a cruel letter gives him the confidence to prove his true worth.

programmes.t: A TikTok Prankster Goes Too Far
programmes.d: Frank "the Prankster" records his escalating pranks on classmates for TikTok fame, causing chaos and damage. When his biggest prank targets the principal, he's caught on camera by his victims. This leads to Frank facing consequences, ultimately apologizing, learning that actions have consequences.

programmes.t: Problem Child Gets World's Strictest Babysitter
programmes.d: After Sasha hangs a bully from a flagpole, her father hires a strict babysitter to discipline her. Sasha tries to rebel, but eventually learns respect before being sent to live in a tiny house.

programmes.t: Two School Pranksters Go Way Too Far
programmes.d: After their mean pranks go too far, pranksters Frank and Jake are forced by their victims to change their ways. They start a viral "kindness prank" channel, proving that humor can be used for good.

programmes.t: Genius Boy Is Kicked Out From Party
programmes.d: Competitive mom Brenda bans Jayden from her son's party for being "too good" at everything. After guests boycott her event for Jayden's, the moms realize kids' friendships shouldn't suffer for parent petty rivalries.

programmes.t: Kid Steals First Ever PlayStation 6, He Lives to Regret It
programmes.d: Eddy breaks into a store to steal a PS6, but only snags an empty display box. After leaving his backpack behind, he's arrested and loses the real console his mom had already hidden for him.

Mean girl Samantha, obsessed with perfection, gets a magic cream that turns her beautiful facade hideous. Humiliated and abandoned, she learns a harsh lesson about inner beauty, prompting a transformation that earns her genuine friendships.

A famous influencer's family is terrorized by an obsessed fan. Her husband, initially dismissive, realizes the danger. He bravely confronts the stalker, saving his family and highlighting that true strength lies in unity and protecting loved ones.

Blackmailed by greedy Demetrius to rob his brother Dominick, homeless Holly discovers Demetrius is the true villain. Dominick outsmarts him, clears Holly's name, and funds her sick mother's treatment.

programmes.t: Girl Falls In Love With Fake Boyfriend
programmes.d: After Meredith is scammed of $1M by an AI catfish, she and her friends track the fraudster to New York. They "scam the scammer" to get the money back. Meredith wins as a journalist and finds true love.

programmes.t: Toxic Friends Don't Know Friend Is Secretly Famous
programmes.d: After being bullied for his weight and mocked for his dream of stand-up, lawyer Jonah quits his job. Guided by comedian Lauren, he finds success and proves his toxic friends and ex-girlfriend wrong.

Once upon a time, 65 millions years ago dinosaurs disappeared forever. But what if they hadn't become extinct?
The awesome power of the Tyrannosaurus Rex and the Triceratops are recreated.
The devastating powers of the Velociraptor and Ankylosaur are examined.
Ralph wants to transform a rusty 1951 Chevy into a Rat Rod  Victor and Eddie convince Ralph to change the design and give the vehicle a full restoration.

Ralph builds a 1958 Chevy Apache from the ground up for a potential buyer  with only the shell of the truck remaining, the team builds a custom exhaust system, adds a unique leather interior and customizes the paint job.
The team makes a 1967 Volkswagen Beetle look like it just rolled out of the factory  graffiti muralist Tristan Eaton's 1967 Lincoln Continental is brought back to life.
Ralph tells the team to finish modernizing his 1958 Chevrolet Impala before he returns from a collector car auction in Connecticut  Ralph customizes a 1972 Triumph Bonneville for the OG Moto Show.
A 1962 Bubble Top is completely modernized  the vehicle receives flush mounted bumpers, a hand-crafted luxury interior, a custom grill and Roman Red paint.

programmes.st: '67 Coronet R/T, Formula Firebird, '49 Woody& 60's Vans at Bernardston Auto Wreckers
programmes.d: Steve Magnante visits Bernardston Auto Wrecking and uncovers a '67 Dodge Coronet R/T, an '89 Pontiac Firebird Formula 350, a '49 Ford Mercury Woody and three vintage vans including a '61 Ford Econoline, a '64 Dodge A100, and a '64 Chevy G-Series van.

programmes.st: Jeep FC And More In Rural PA
programmes.d: Steve visits rural Pennsylvania and unearths a rare heavy-duty, cab-forward Jeep, a classic 1958 Ford Courier sedan delivery two-door station wagon, a 1967 Ford Fairlane GTA muscle car and a Petty Blue 1973 Plymouth Road Runner 340 four-speed.

programmes.st: Four-Speed Mercury Cougar, and More in Denver, CO
programmes.d: Steve visits Colorado Auto & Parts searching for vintage metal  he finds a 1965 Mustang 2 plus 2 four-speed, a 1968 390, four-speed Mercury Cougar, a 1968 Pontiac GTO convertible and a 1970 Chrysler 300 Hurst convertible mystery car.

programmes.st: '62 Dodge Lancer GT, '61 DeSoto, '54 Dodge Royal Pace Car, and More Mopars in Sandy, OR
programmes.d: Steve travels to Sandy, OR, to pay homage to the Chrysler Corporation, with a look into the past at Wildcat Auto Wrecking  he finds a 1962 aluminum block Dodge Lancer GT, a 1961 DeSoto, a trio of 1979 Chrysler 300s and a 1954 Dodge Royal Pace Car.

programmes.st: More Fight for Survival in Vancouver, Washington
programmes.d: All American Classics, a popular salvage yard in Vancouver, Wash., has been forced to downsize due to city expansion and rising taxes  that doesn't stop Steve Magnante from finding what he's looking for in this classic auto salvage yard.

programmes.st: More Awesome Finds in Denton, Texas
programmes.d: In Denton, Texas, Steve Magnate ends up hooking an AMC Marlin, finding a factory-built V-8 Vega, digging around in an ex-law enforcement Plymouth sedan the Blues Brothers would love and uncovering a super-rare, dual-quad four-door Buick.
Tomeka says her boyfriend, Marc, is a cheater who is using her for her money  he blames her past relationships.

Timothy doesn't trust his fiancée Jessica's relationships with her male friends  she says he is insecure and overzealous about catching her cheating, and she has no privacy due to him spying on her and checking her phone every opportunity he gets.

Dominique says she can no longer stay in her marriage and watch Sylvester kill himself with his drinking  she wants him to get help for his drinking problem, but he says he enjoys drinking and wants her to understand that he's never going to change.
Divorce Court features real stories from real couples who have already filed for divorce and agree to have the judge mediate their disputes.

Raheem says Steven can't control his emotions, especially when he's drinking, and lashes out in anger  Steven says his boyfriend is the reason for all their problems, because he is overly controlling and betrayed his trust, possibly beyond repair.

Amber says Jasmine took out a $10,000 loan to fuel her gambling addiction and may be cheating with a secret benefactor who helped her pay it off  Jasmine argues that Amber belittles her by constantly hanging money over her head.
Judge Star Jones uses her wisdom and experience as she presides over the courtroom, hearing disputes involving the highs and lows of relationships.

Benita says fiancé Jorge has canceled 20 different dates she has set to get married  he says he is more focused on buying them a house rather than an overpriced wedding, and he's committed to her but doesn't want to be pressured into marriage.

Qolett says fiancé Demo allowed a woman to twerk on his Jeep at an event and has seen videos on social media of him getting too close to his female "friends"  he says she is just jealous of the attention his Jeep gets, and she tracks his every move.
After proposing two years ago, Kelly got a better-paying job and moved out of state, and Latrice was supposed to follow, but Kelly believes another woman prevented her from moving.
Latta says Joie has threatened to leave her for another woman during arguments they've had  Joie says Latta is inconsiderate, never at home and denies her sex.
Mitzi says Juan lets his family members convince him that she is promiscuous  he says he found sexually explicit text messages from one of her exes on her phone and is ready to end things.

Amy says her husband, Ricardo, fathered four children outside their relationship, and she wants a divorce  Ricardo says the stress of co-parenting Amy's four children from a previous relationship led to the downfall of their marriage.
Logan says he doesn't know if his and Danielle's relationship will last if she doesn't conform to a polyamorous lifestyle  she says she met the other woman and wants him to cut things off with her.
Pashion says husband Joshua's constant disrespect and perusing of women on social media have become too much for her to handle.
Troy says he's had enough of his girlfriend's accusations of cheating and if things don't change, he's done  Victoria says Troy's multiple baby mamas could be the downfall of their relationship.

Donna says she's ready to call off her engagement to Jeffery because he'd rather spend time with his military friends than with her  Jeffery says Donna is overreacting and calling off the wedding is the wrong decision.

Reset your family without a blow-up  Dr. Phil shows how to spot toxic roles, run a calm family summit, and create simple house rules everyone follows.

programmes.d: Are we protecting kids or weakening them? Dr. Phil examines how over-rescuing children may be fueling anxiety, entitlement and fragility, then turns the mirror on adults trapped by the same excuses, avoidance and old life scripts.

programmes.d: Strange emergency room stories  inmate sues jail over erection  dad arrested for selling heroin in the maternity ward  a high school's lunch segregation controversy  pimple-popping nails  corporate sponsors for weddings.

programmes.d: Tara had big dreams when she married Steve  now, she feels like she's signed on to a life of misery and a mother-in-law who butts into their business.

programmes.d: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife  she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills!

She seemed like any other well-behaved girl… until she opened her mouth. It was obvious from the beginning that she had a quick wit and undeniable sense of humor.

When a heat wave turns the warehouse into a sweatshop, the guys head to the lake and create their very own redneck water park  Willie hires the handy Mountain Man to fix the air conditioning.
Spring-cleaning in the warehouse leads to a competitive round of table tennis  Uncle Si makes a long-overdue visit to the eye doctor.
Willie gets bit by the broadcasting bug and decides to host his own radio show  the neighborhood homeowners association goes after Jase.
The guys pig out at a new doughnut shop  Si wins a camper in a raffle and uses it as his personal office  Phil and Miss Kay drag Willie along on a furniture-buying excursion.
Jase and Si damage a samurai sword that was given to Willie from a Japanese business associate  Willie and Phil give Sadie shooting lessons.
The Duck Commander guys go on strike when Willie implements motivational work tactics  Miss Kay brings her home cooking to the streets of West Monroe.
NASCAR driver Clint Bowyer visits the warehouse, leading to a drag race showdown between Willie and Clint  Phil and Si attempt to fix Miss Kay's barbecue.

programmes.d: The Robertson family gears up for the holidays  Miss Kay creates a special four-meat dish  Willie plays Santa at a church event for children  Jase and the men attempt to put up Christmas lights.
The men camp out the evening before the opening of duck season  Miss Kay rebuffs unbathed Phil's romantic advances.
Willie tries to shed some pounds before his high-school reunion  Si seeks his own pet when he believes Phil's hunting dogs don't like him.
When John Luke goes through his first breakup, the guys take him hunting and give him relationship advice  Phil and Kay seek the services of a pet photographer from the city.
Expert trapper Phil is called in when the warehouse guys lose their pet lizard  Willie and Si ride along with members of the West Monroe Police Department.
While ditching work, Si spots what he believes is the infamous "black panther"  Phil tries to get his football-playing nephew and his teammate to do chores.
A husband-and-wife deer hunt leads to a battle of wills in the woods  Si helps Miss Kay search through piles of her belongings to find the original blueprints for Phil's first duck call.

programmes.t: Judy Moody and the NOT Bummer Summer
programmes.d: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

Dong Joo is transferred to Dr. Kim's hospital, and he starts questioning every single move made by the veteran surgeon. On the other hand, Seo Jung finds him quite annoying since he doesn't get the idea that Dr. Kim is trying to get across. Doldam Hospital faces many cases, and now it's up to Seo Jung and Dong Joo to figure out how to finish up each operation without displeasing Dr. Kim.

Dr. Kim shows up at the hospital with a bruised face, but he's out to save a burn victim first. The general manager of the casino comes to the hospital to take care of all the charges, but they're faced with a charge for putting a bruise on Dr. Kim's face. Meanwhile, Dong Joo and Seo Jung clear things out between themselves as Dong Joo wants to leave the hospital for good.

Bu Yong Ju is back. This worries the chairman and prompts for an emergency meeting at the Geosan University Medical Center. Dong Joo says that Gi Tae can shred his resignation letter if Dr. Kim turns out to be Dr. Bu Yong Ju, and he plans to continue working at Doldam Hospital. First, they've got to attend to a set of cyclists that get hit by a truck with a driver that had fallen asleep.

Seo Jung meets In Bum after years of not seeing each other. Dong Joo is worried about him and is quite displeased to have him at the hospital. That's after In Bum steps past his borders. Seo Jung recalls her past as a student who lost her mother and her memories spent with the president's family. Dr. Kim now talks about matters related to the foundation and the future of their hospital.

Details There's a standoff at the lobby of the Doldam Hospital. This time, it's In Bum and Hyeon Cheol versus Dr. Kim and the rest of the staff. The dispute isn't over after all the talks that had happened, and the future of Doldam seems to be entering murky waters of this devilish foggy forest of no hope. The micromanagement of President Do is getting in the way of Dr. Kim. For now, Seo Jung handles an 8 in a hundred chance of survival surgery.

A hostage-taking crisis happens in the operating room. The victim at the edge of the knife is Seo Jung, with the sole request is to stop the surgery that currently takes place. The medical team informs the police, but the armed suspect is ready to kill Seo Jung at any minute. With two people's lives on the line, Dr. Kim needs to think fast.

Dr. Kim comes back unexpectedly, as they all thought he was still under investigation. Everyone doesn't also expect Dr. Kim's new visitor, who happens to be Chairman Shin himself. After being mocked by Hyeon Cheol for being incompetent, Dr. Kim now operates on the big boss. After Dong Joo speaks up of the truth of the unjust treatment received by Doldam Hospital, the chairman makes an important phone call.
Ujae continues to work hard to get on Seoyeong's good side... Seongjae's unsuccessful with his first debut... And Jiseon continues to get closer to the magician to get a huge shock at the end.

The family celebrate Seollal... Gangsun's still alone and Jiseon decides to call it quits with Gibeom... It seems for real this time. Seoyeong visit home and says hello to her mother for the first time in 3 years... She seems to be getting closer and closer to Ujae.

Seoyeong finally finds out the truth behind Migyeong and Sangu... It provides room for her to try and think from Ujae's perspective. Hojeong has a major misunderstanding with Sangu and ends up in danger…
Seoyeong and Ujae get more of an opportunity to come together as Seoyeong decides to go hiking on her own to reflect. She learns that perhaps she's been the most immature of everyone…
Seoyeong and Ujae seem to be getting back together. Things are going well until they all head off on a family trip... Gibeom tries his best to try and get back with Jiseon.

Just as things were finally getting better between Seoyeong and her father... They're hit with a bombshell! Will Samjae be okay? Will Seoyeong and her family get back together just like the other couples in the drama?

Raon disguises herself as a man named Samnom and does all kinds of work to earn money, pay off the debts and find her mother. One day, she is kidnapped by the moneylenders, and they sell her to the Office of Eunuch Attendants to get their money back. She happens to work as a eunuch when she is a woman.

To become the official eunuch, the trainees have to pass three exams which are the physical fitness, the written exam and the character test. They will be kicked out of the palace once they fail at least one of them. In order to escape, Raon tries to fail, however, Yeong intentionally helps Raon so that she cannot escape from the palace.

The King personally orders Raon to deliver his response of Consort Park's letter, and it turns out to be a secret letter written with apple vinegar. Meanwhile, Yeong realizes that the King has been doing nothing just to protect his people. In order to share his burden, Yeong suggests the King to command him to take the throne in the interim.

Yeong suggests the King and the Ministers to get the Qing Dynasty's approval of his taking the throne in the interim after the King's birthday festival. The Ministers and the Queen plan to ruin the festival, but it proceeds successfully with Raon's help. After the final performance, Yeong commands Premier Kim to give a congratulatory speech in front of everyone including the envoy.

The mysterious maiden who performed the solo dance during the King's birthday festival is nowhere to be found, and the Crown Prince suspects Eunuch Hong to be the one. Meanwhile, Raon is given a vacation and she plans to attend the Lantern Festival in the village. While she is waiting for Yunseong, she runs into the Crown Prince and they fly a wish lantern together.

Eunuch Ma secretly tells Envoy Mok Taegam that Eunuch Hong is a girl and the dancer he has been desperately looking for. The envoy calls in Raon to his room at night, and the Crown Prince stops him right when he is about to harass her. However, the Crown Prince gets into trouble due to his disrespectful attitude toward the envoy.

Eunuch Ma and Wolhee must end their relationship because a eunuch and court lady's love cannot be done. Eunuch Hong attempts to deliver his sincerity through a puppet play, and Eunuch Ma professes his feelings for her in front of people. Meanwhile, despite of the rumors and his status, the Crown Prince decides not to hide his feelings toward Eunuch Hong.

A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. While on a mission to the big city to replace Nicole's malfunctioning microchip, Sonic and Sally encounter the Guardian, a mysterious cloaked figure who guards a dormant wizard named Lazar and his computer of evil spells.
Sonic is hired into an obvious trap when a frustrated Robotnik decides to appeal to the Hedgehog's ego and announces a "race to determine the fastest on Mobius".

Sonic conquers Robotnik's latest evil - a vehicle designated to locate and destroy living tissue matter - during a solo mission to the Badlands. Upon Sonic's return, the Freedom Fighters honor him with a victory party.

When Robotnik launches a spy-orb that will uncover the Freedom Fighter's Knothole location, Sonic and Robot launch themselves up to the orbiting spy-sphere aboard a home-made rocket powered by Robotnik's discarded booster engine.
Robotnik announces that he will marry Queen Aleena in a plot to become the king of Mobius.
A captain of the Queen's guard is captured before he can reach the secret rendezvous where he was to meet Queen Aleena.
A homecoming is interrupted for Sonic, Sonia and Manic when Sleet and Dingo arrive to collect back taxes after returning to their birthplace.
Sonia discovers that the watch she received from her friend is actually a monitoring device for the Robotnik Intelligence Agency.
Sleet and Dingo plan to collect the taxes owed to Robotnik from the Duke of Velcronia but keep it for themselves.
The sinister Robotnik blackmails Cyrus, an old friend of Sonic's, by holding his father hostage.
On a trip to Port Mobius, Sonic, Manic and Sonia are told that ships are sinking due to the Mobian sea-beast.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programmes.d: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! programmes.st: Storytellers - "Trinity Oaks - Bucks for the Brave
programmes.d: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinit

John Sewell has played a huge part in the development of feeding Fortified Cottonseed 365 days a year. Laramie Barrett of Fortified Cottonseed joins John for a great weekend of hunting at his ranch in Uvalde, Texas. This is a great time for Laramie to get away from the office and see the first hand of how their product is performing.
We love our college chapters. Hudson has been a long time member of TTHA as well as serving with the Texas A&M Chapter. We have a great time at G2 in pursuit of Axis deer.

Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. Texas provides a wide variety of game, and chasing these creatures all across the state is some of the best times had.

Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season. This year, our friends from Struttinbuck did just the same. Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks right on the Mexico border.

This week we are rolling along side the crew from Double T Outfitters. Management plays a huge role in every outfitters success every year. Bret and his team have a strong management plan in place and these guys had a blast with a group of out of state hunters.

This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

Capt. Blair has some down time in Alaska, so what does he do? Heads to the beach to check out the salmon hatchery in Ketchican. They've met their quota for the year so the season is open, but the trick is how to catch the salmon. There hasn't been an episode like this yet.

When the captain calls and says the weather in Alaska is great, you don't waste the opportunity. So Capt. Blair and the whole crew head out for a day of fishing. With one camera on the boat, things got a little chaotic with all the catching going on.
After multiple days in Alaska, it was time for the last trip out to sea. The crew got to experience the sights on this trip, like God Valley and others. And of course catch more Alaskan fish.
Down in Sebastion, the monster snook wait. These fish are so elusive, men have gotten divorced chasing these things. These can be once in a lifetime fish, and even then it's not a guarantee.

Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii's coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

The crew finally makes it out of the Seefra system, and discover Dylan is the last Paradine; the World Ship wasn't destroyed, and Nietzscheans have begun their plan to destroy Earth.
In the series finale, the final battle to save the New Systems Commonwealth begins.
After being left stranded near a black hole, Capt Dylan Hunt is discovered by a mercenary salvage ship to find he has been frozen in time for 300 years.
Dylan protects the Andromeda from the mercenaries while Beka starts to wonder if they are fighting for the wrong side.
Dylan finds a space station full of kids who believe he is there to bring peace by killing their enemies. He is manipulated into unlocking his weapons locker.
The crew of Andromeda is still learning how to work together as they are attacked by the Restorers.
The Andromeda gets involved in a feud between a Than planet and a Nietzschean colony. Tyr must choose between his clan or his new family aboard the Andromeda.
A slipstream sends the Andromeda back in time to just before the Commonwealth fell. The crew must intervene to preserve history.
Answering a distress call leads the crew to pick up Beka's brother, now a Wayist, and his friend. They are connected to environmentalists trying to prevent space travel.
A black hole allows Dylan to communicate with his former fiancee, 300 years in the past. He can't abandon his mission to reform the Commonwealth, but can he bring her into the future?
Dylan is imprisoned on a prison planet and must stage an escape as his crew tries to stage their own rescue.
Castalians board the Andromeda to finalize the charter for the New Commonwealth. When the leader is discovered dead, Tyr is the main suspect.

programmes.st: The Pearls That Were His Eyes
programmes.d: Beka learns that her father's former business partner deals in a highly addictive drug called Flash. The rest of the crew holds a "garage sale" to earn money for new ship parts.
The Andromeda discovers her "sister ship", the Pax Magellanic.  The crew aboard Pax is 300 years old, but have not aged a day
Tyr crash lands the Eureka Maru on a Nietzschean planet and develops amnesia. He must remember what he is doing before the Nietzscheans discover him and his crate of stolen goods.
Harper receives the "gift" of knowledge from a dying Perseid, only to discover that the Perseid was being hunted by a bounty hunter, who has now turned his attention to Harper.
Dylan is arrested for assassinating a dictator 300 years ago, by the man he helped install in his place. The new dictator ended up being much, much worse.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: I'm an Alien
programmes.d: While on their way to school, Josuke and Okuyasu find a young man lying unconscious in the middle of what appears to be a crop circle.  When they try to take a closer look, the man suddenly wakes up and starts claiming he’s an alien from outer space.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Highway Go Go, Part 1
programmes.d: Rohan is convinced that Josuke is cheating in their game of Cee-lo when all the dice rolls in his opponent’s favor. Feeling insulted, Rohan stabs his own finger and swear he’ll find out how Josuke is cheating in their next round.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Highway Go Go, Part 2
programmes.d: Rohan sacrifices himself to save Josuke from a remote-controlled Stand that sucks nutrients out of its victims. Moved by Rohan’s act of bravery, Josuke races through town to find and defeat the Stand’s user before it can kill Rohan.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Cats Love Yoshikage Kira
programmes.d: Shinobu tells her husband, Kosaku, that she saw a stray cat in their basement with a hole in its throat. When Kosaku goes down to take a look, he finds the cat already dead, The next morning, a strange plant sprouts from the spot where the cat was buried.

Yoshihiro Kira spots Kosaku Kawajiri and instantly recognizes that it’s actually his son, Yoshikage. Meanwhile, Josuke, Okuyasu, and Mikitaka find a strange man living in an abandoned electrical tower.

Josuke enters the electrical tower again to save Mikitaka and defeat Toyohiro Kanedaichi. Meanwhile, Rohan receives a visit from a first-class architect named Masazo Kinoto, who’s come to estimate the repair costs to his burnt house.

Rohan finds himself possessed by Masazo Kinoto’s Stand, Cheap Trap, who tells the manga artist to burn the photos he took of the people in Morioh. Meanwhile, Josuke and Yuya encounter the Stand user responsible for Koichi’s disappearance.
Rohan calls over Koichi to help him fight off Cheap Trap, which has attached itself onto Rohan’s back. Unfortunately, Koichi thinks Rohan is pulling a prank on him and leaves.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bites the Dust, Part 1
programmes.d: Kosaku Kawajiri is forced to kill Hayato after the boy threatens to expose him as a killer.  To make matter worse, Kosaku learns from his father, Yoshihiro, that Rohan and the others are coming to investigate the Kawajiri family shortly.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bites the Dust, Part 2
programmes.d: Yoshikage Kira gains a new ability called Bites the Dust, a bomb that automatically kills anyone who tries to discover Kira’s identity through Hayato. Realizing that the only people who could stop Kira are ones with similar powers.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 1
programmes.d: Hayato’s attempt to kill Kira using Stray Cat’s air bullet ends in failure. Kira realizes that letting Hayato repeat the same morning is becoming a risk, so he decides to undo Bites the Dust after he sees through Rohan’s death.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and Hayato hide inside a nearby residence to escape from Deadly Queen and Stray Cat’s attack. But to their horror, Kira is somehow able to close in on them from outside the house.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Goodbye, Morioh – The Heart of Gold
programmes.st: Goodbye, Morioh – The Heart of Gold
programmes.d: Josuke and his friends have finally cornered Yoshikage Kira. Refusing to give up, Kira tries to activate Bites the Dust one more time to escape his desperate situation. Can Josuke and the others stop Kira in time to save the future of Morioh?

Amid the gritty beauty of Neapolis, the Joestar lineage lives on in Giorno Giovanna. After sidestepping long-term Joestar ally Koichi Hirose, Giorno must contend with two powerful Mafia gangsters, Leaky Eye Lucca and the enigmatic Bruno Bucciarati.

Eager to identify Leaky Eye Luca’s attacker, Bucciarati confronts Giorno and unleashes a Stand attack to dismantle him piece by piece. But Giorno counters with his Stand Golden Wind, surprising not just his adversary, but also himself.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
programmes.st: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
programmes.d: Determined to join the mafia gang Passione, altruistic Giorno is introduced by Bucciarati to the grotesquely corpulent Polpo, an incarcerated capo who tests Giorno’s loyalty with a simple but bizarrely lethal test involving a lighter and its flame.
Though he's been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him.
It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero, and he has yet to do anything heroic.
An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z. Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.
A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrives on the shores of City J, intent on invading the land.
After suffering a mortal wound, Shizuka dies in Ichiru’s arms. Meanwhile, Yuki and Zero try to find where Shizuka may have gone, but Zero is constantly thwarted by his Level E seizures…
After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. As usual, Yuki is busy with her duties as Guardian when Zero, who has been gone for quite some time, comes back.
Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.
The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy because he suspects Kaname had something to do with Shizuka’s death.
Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group attempts to kill Matsuda of the task force, and is surprised when he doesn't die after 40 seconds.
Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.
Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.
Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.
A new investigator steps forward, Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.
Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell, Day 1
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell set off from the Lake District. Expect a portable Victorian loo, a toy lion and three unhappy bears. Plus, the medieval stained glass windows at Carlisle Cathedral and the poet Robert Southey.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell, Day 2
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell continue their antiquing adventure around the Scottish Borders with food on their mind, picking up a fish service, a sandwich box and a silver kettle.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell, Day 3
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell hunt for antiques in Scotland. While Natasha picks up some French candlesticks and an Italian paperweight, Phil reverts to type and buys old, weighty farm troughs.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell, Day 4
programmes.d: Still in Scotland, experts Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell find rare first edition books, watercolors by local artists and a plate of delicious homemade scones. And the pair take a trip across the water to a Belfast auction.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Philip Serrell, Day 5
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Phil Serrell shop in Northern Ireland before an auction in Wales. They uncover a Majolica tea service, Irish fiddle and a bowler hat. A bidding frenzy helps one expert take the win and the Road Trip crown.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey, Day 1
programmes.d: Newcomer Margie Cooper battles it out with veteran Mark Stacey, starting the week in Chilham, Kent, and ending at auction in Heathfield, East Sussex.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey, Day 2
programmes.d: It couldn't be closer as Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey go hunting that antique gem, from Rochester in Kent to a showdown in Colchester in Essex.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey, Day 3
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey continue their journey, from Sawbridgeworth in Hertfordshire to an auction in Chippenham, Wiltshire.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey, Day 4
programmes.d: Its day four. Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey start the day in the New Forest in Hampshire ending at an auction showdown in Sherborne.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey, Day 5
programmes.d: It's all down to the last lot as Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey battle it out to from in Hele Exeter to Torquay for the final auction showdown.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Mark Hales, Day 1
programmes.d: Old-hand Thomas Plant and newbie Mark Hales take to the road, going head-to-head as they try and out-buy and out-sell each other. They start their journey in Portrush, Northern Ireland and end up for an auction in Belfast.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Mark Hales, Day 2
programmes.d: It's game-on as Thomas Plant and Mark Hales travel from Dublin to Ballybrittas, Portlaoise, in the Republic of Ireland for an auction showdown

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Mark Hales, Day 3
programmes.d: It's day three for Thomas Plant and Mark Hales as they battle for the biggest profit. Beginning in Ironbridge, Shropshire, they head to Froncysyllte in North Wales for the auction.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Mark Hales, Day 4
programmes.d: Thomas Plant and Mark Hales battle it out as they start the day in Newport Pembrokeshire and end up at auction showdown Llandeilo in Carmarthenshire.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Mark Hales, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the last day for Thomas Plant and Mark Hales. They begin in Hay-on-Wye and it's all down to the deciding auction in Pontrilas in Herefordshire.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Jonathan Pratt, Day 1
programmes.d: It's a fresh route for a new set of experts: Phil Serrell and Jonathan Pratt. Their first stop is Cockermouth in the Lake District, ending up in Kirkby Lonsdale for auction.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Jonathan Pratt, Day 2
programmes.d: Phil Serrell and Jonathan Pratt continue their hunt for bargains starting in Corbridge and ending up with an auction showdown in Northallerton.

George's dad Papa Papadapolis picks up a new hobby and ends up on a date with the instructor: a belly dancing teacher!
Webster runs the campaign of a class presidential candidate.

When Lisa forbids Tia to see her boyfriend Michael, Tamera acts as a go-between for the couple -- but finds herself falling for him.
Tia and Tamera take their sisterly bond a little too far when they collide with each other's cars while learning to drive.
When the "cool crowd" doesn't invite Tia and Tamera to their "happening" party, the twins decide to throw a bash of their own -- which could wind up being a "bust"!

When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.
Sandra writes a steamy romance novel based on characters that are suspiciously similar to her friends at 227.
Mary's new job with a travel agency takes her out-of-town on business with her boss, leaving a jealous Lester at home. Special guest appearance by Garrett Morris.

When Malcolm falls for a spiritual guru and Eddie gets a new job offer, they agree to sell the business and move on.

When Vanessa and Geneva get stranded in the middle of a forest due to a broken down car, Mark is forced to chaperone Nicole's slumber party by himself.
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.
Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.
Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

Moesha starts having recurring romantic dreams about Hakeem, giving her second thoughts about their friendship and about sharing a room with him and Niecy on an upcoming ski trip.

Family issues keep Mike busy.

As Erin prosecutes a woman accused of killing her husband, the defendant's attorney is murdered and Danny is assigned to the investigation.
Danny is put in a difficult position when a gun linked to a robbery is brought in to the NYPD's gun buyback program.
Danny causes waves in the department when he investigates a closed case, the suicide of a firefighter, at the insistence of the man's 12-year-old son.
Danny and Jackie are assigned to protect a key witness in a Russian mob trial, but when an attempt is made on her life, they realize there is a leak on the task force.
Danny and Jackie investigate the suspicious death of a high-rolling investor who sustained injuries in a fight, yet his hands are unmarked by trauma.
Frank must race to stop a biological weapon attack on New York City while keeping it a secret from his family during their most sentimental holiday, Mother's Day.
A dangerous criminal from Danny's past comes back to seek revenge and kidnaps Jackie. Meanwhile, Jamie meets his new partner.

When an injured woman recants her claim of domestic violence, Danny and Jackie look into it further, only to find that the woman is involved in a secret relationship with a high-powered councilman who also happens to be a friend of Frank's.
Danny believes a serial killer is on the loose when two separate murder victims are identified as members of a group charged with a gang rape.
Danny and Jackie set out to investigate the murder of a bride on her wedding day in a drive-by gang shooting.
When Erin's key witness, an infamous photographer, is nearly killed in a hit and run, she arranges for Danny to work protection detail to safeguard him.

Shortly after Frank awards a detective with the Medal of Valor for his undercover work for the NYPD in Malaysia, the detective is taken hostage by a Malaysian drug lord whose brother he helped put in prison.
When a knife-wielding attacker dressed as Baron Samedi, the Spirit of Death, stabs a man in costume on Halloween, Danny enters the world of voodoo.
Danny arrives at a college campus to find a murdered student, who was thought to be dealing drugs.
When two motorists driving gas-guzzling cars die at the hands of a sniper, Danny and Kate are put on the case of what the city believes is the work of a radical environmental serial killer.
When Danny and Kate come up empty-handed with leads for a shooting, Linda helps make a break in the case when she overhears the victim telling his priest who is responsible.
Jamie must deal with the emotional consequences of his actions on the job.
The Cartwrights' cousin, Clarissa visits. Her assertive, snobbish ways result in nothing but trouble for Ben and his sons.
After his only friend is killed, the Cartwrights take in a slow-witted man, who Roy Coffee informs them, is wanted for murder by Arizona authorities.
While out hunting for a mountain lion, Joe accidentally shots Tessa Caldwell causing her to go blind.  As a result of his guilt, Joe ends up proposing to the girl.

Hoss chooses a difficult path when he decides to rehabilitate a famous poet, Will Smith, who is really William Warlock Evans, who spends too much time drinking and eventually his wife arrives at the Ponderosa.

programmes.st: A Pink Cloud Comes from Old Cathay
programmes.d: A headstrong Chinese girl (Marlo Thomas) visiting the Cartwrights incites labor unrest among local workers.

Renowned English novelist Charles Dickens comes to Virginia City. In short order, he is accused of a crime he didn't commit. The problem then becomes how to convince the stubborn author to defend himself.
Outlaws capture Ben and hide him in an abandoned mine, holding him for a ransom.  The boys must come up with a plan to save him before it's too late.
Hoss develops amnesia after being bushwhacked and hit over the head by two outlaws and moves in with a Dutch couple.
One of Joe's old girlfriends thinks he killed her husband so they could come together.  Unfortunately, that is what her husband's twin brother also believes.
Ben and Hoss unwittingly aid a vengeful army colonel who plans to wipe out every Indian he can with a Gatling gun.

Sam Logan is released from jail after serving his twenty year sentence for stealing $100,000 worth of gold dust.  He is followed by a bounty hunter who believes Sam will lead him to where the gold is buried.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City.  In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
Mateo Ibara and his wife Carla visit the Ponderosa.  Ibara asks Will to return to Mexico with him. Ibara and Will fought together for Juarez's cause and Ibara saved Will's life.
After their stagecoach crashes, a group of rag-tag passengers and Joe must get out of the desert alive.  One of the passengers may or may not be a murderer and Joe is accused.
Joe struggles to understand whether his friend was right in killing a dying man who pleaded to put out of his misery.
Hilarious sequel to "Any Friend Of Walter's" in which Obie leaves Walter in Hoss' care.
Ben's attempt to rehabilitate an alcoholic singer he knew in better days are complicated by her involvment with a former prize fighter.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.
Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki.
Kagura unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.
The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village!

programmes.st: The Sharingan vs. The Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang!
programmes.d: Sarada is forced into one-on-one combat with a kunoichi, Buntan Kurosuki, who wields the Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang! In the thick fog, Sarada uses her Sharingan, but her enemy is stronger than expected
Boruto urges his friend Kagura to return with him, but Kagura rejects him and begins to attack.
The field trip comes to an end, and Boruto and his friends prepare to return to Hidden Leaf. Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off, but Kagura is nowhere to be seen.
Inojin has loved to draw since he was small, and his ninjutsu speciality is the Super Beast Scroll. But one day, he suddenly loses his ability to use his jutsu!

programmes.st: The Night of the Shooting Stars
programmes.d: Boruto and his classmates decide to go camping to try to catch the mysterious fish, the Eternal Carp, said to be unforgettably delicious.
As the students prepare for their finals, Boruto meets a journalist named Sukea who is doing a story on them.

Boruto and the others complete the first-round written exam and move on to the next. The second round has the students facing off against Kakashi and the academy instructors in actual combat situations.
Boruto's the first to confront Kakashi in the exam. Despite a determined effort, he is immobilized and angered by Kakashi's severe criticism of his class.
Boruto and his classmates take their first step as genin and start forming their basic shinobi three-man squads.

programmes.st: The Path Lit by the Full Moon
programmes.d: Mitsuki faces a difficult decision, but his thoughts and feelings that had once been shrouded in mystery, now come to light.
Team 7 sets out on their first mission.
Team 7's original mission evolves into a rescue operation after Kiri is kidnapped.
Team 7 is assigned to capture a suspect who has barricaded himself inside a bank.
An incident occurs in Hidden Leaf Village and the Byakuya Gang is suspected.
The Byakuya Gang's activities become more brazen in the Hidden Leaf.

programmes.st: Memories from the Day of Snow
programmes.d: Ryogi is worried about Shikadai, but is tormented by memories he can't forget.

programmes.st: Go! The Crest of Night Strategy
programmes.d: The protest instigated by the Byakuya Gang against the Kaminarimon Company increases in intensity.

programmes.st: The Figure I Want to Be
programmes.d: Shikadai figures out what the Byakuya Gang's goal is and rushes after them in pursuit with Boruto close by.
Udon Ise the jonin captain of Team 5, issues a direct order from the Hokage to Iwabe, Denki and Metal.
Sumire, Wasabi and Namida are given a mission to recover animals that someone has released from their cages at the zoo.

Grissom and his team investigate the death of a first class passenger on a flight to Las Vegas.

Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.

Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.
In this fantastical action film, martial arts legend Jackie Chan stars as a police inspector tracking down a deranged villain who is out to kidnap his daughter.

In 'Big Top Pinky,' Pinky dreams of stardom in the circus and discovers his calling is as a clown. And in 'Yeti 'nother Bigfoot Story,' custodian Pinky, after running a museum display, travels to Alaska in search of Bigfoot.

Itchy and Killer are caught by a dog catcher who chains the two dogs to each other. They have to work as partners and in harmony with each other to get out of the situation. In the end Itchy and Killer find a new appreciation for each other.

Charlie has begun taking on the moniker of the 'Lyin' King' after being proud of how often he lies and gets away with it. This backfires on him, however, after he misuses a Miracle Dog Tag and lies to Anabelle after she confronts him about it.

Charlie has become bored with his life as a Guardian Angel. Every day is the same routine. What he really needs in his life is a little excitement. After getting knocked in the head Charlie dreams that he's living another life, in another time.

Charlie and Itchy are magically shrunk down to mouse size in order to help some mice in danger of losing their home to pollution. When they find out some of the toxic waste is coming from Carface's shop, they work to shut down an elaborate machine.
Pam's sheepdog, Daisy, gets loose and chases Ballard the cat.  When Mr. Conroy is called to catch Daisy, he bumps into Grandpa, switches glasses with him, and takes him to the pound instead of Daisy.
A film about a mean and violent werewolf is shot in Wolverton. Outraged by the poor misrepresentation of werewolves, Scott decides to be a stuntman in order to change the horror film into a comedy.
Scott becomes infatuated with Shayna the She-Wolf, a T.V. personality who he believes to be a real teen wolf, like himself. He and Stiles decide to travel to Hollywood and find her.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.
Gem and Sabrina are teamed up to work on a book report.
Sabrina’s baseball team is on a major losing streak. And Gem is there to point it out.
When it seems like Hilda isn’t going to pass a test for her mortal driver’s license, Sabrina conjures up a cute driving instructor to help & inspire her.
Enchantra comes to town for her Annual Witch Evaluation test.
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.

On a white wintry day, Vonderland celebrates, “Festivus Solarus." Verne becomes smitten with a pretty young, visiting Spanish astrologer, who snubs him when she realizes he is a Mortie.  Verne feels like a misfit in both worlds, magic and Mortie.

ELSA, a young Giantess, becomes the newest student at the school and Cassy's roommate. ZARLAK takes control over LUCREZIA'S mind through a magic gemstone. He uses her to make it look like Cassy is tormenting Elsa, who finally runs away.
Gus has an incredible string of good luck culminating in his becoming the captain of the school's Soomer-crosse team. When Cassy becomes jealous of her pal's success.
When Gus and Cassy accidentally sit in Siege Perilous, the legendary throne of Galahad created by Merlin, they begin to return to their magical “roots.”
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
During Errie's annual Tornado day, Matt Frewer drops in as a wacky meteorologist whom Marshall helps battle Tornado Bob.
Marshall and Simon are startled by a creepy kid who's living in an old mill that's haunted by the ghost of Eerie's worst bank robber ever.
Trickery makes Marshall the new Harvest King, and he finds the king's traditional task no treat:  he must venture to see the Eerie Wolf, which turns out to be a werewolf.
Marshall and Simon must really use their heads to crack open the real story behind a homeless man who seems to have lost his mind.
It's a dark and stormy night when Mildred and Camille's car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.
A Mad Scientist went missing in the 1930's.

Maris is arrested for the murder of her boyfriend. The press goes wild when they find out that Niles inadvertently loaned her the crossbow that was used as the murder weapon.

Lilith comes to town for a psychiatric conference, and Frasier arranges to meet with her. Before he does so, a colleague of Lilith's sets him up on a blind date with her, not knowing who he really is.

programmes.st: The Ann Who Came to Dinner

Desperate to add some excitement to his life, Frasier does something completely out of character.
Daphne and Niles prepare for their baby's arrival, and Frasier looks for love.
Frasier is taken with Charlotte, but she already has a boyfriend, a handsome man named Frank. To try and get his mind off her, Roz takes him to a singles bar.

A terra cotta cheese crock becomes a time capsule for Frasier.
Both personally and professionally, Frasier's life is about to change forever.
Frasier, Niles, Daphne, Martin, and Roz move on to new chapters in their lives.
Psychiatrist Frasier Crane returns to his hometown of Seattle to host a radio talk show, but soon discovers he could use a shrink himself when his disabled father moves in.
Fed up with a lack of privacy at home and at work, Frasier decides it's time for his father to move out.
It's a culinary culture clash when Frasier and Niles join their father for dinner at his favorite restaurant.
After trading barbs with a newspaper columnist, Frasier rises to the challenge of a fist fight.
Frasier buys Martin a telescope as a gift, leading to a long-distance relationship with a woman named Irene.
Frasier is furious when he learns that his newest art purchase is actually a fake.
Frasier faces a personal and professional dilemma when he begins dating the ex-girlfriend of one of his radio show callers.
When Frasier and Niles see their father dining with an old family friend, they conclude that Martin once had an affair with the woman.
When Frasier is lured into doing on-air endorsements, his professional credibility comes under fire.

Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

Lucy has misplaced her and Ethel's train tickets to Florida and they must share a ride with strange Mrs. Grundy. Mrs Grundy's odd behavior becomes more troubling to Lucy and Ethel when they learn that an escaped hatchet murderess matches her description.

While on vacation in Florida, Lucy and Ethel go on a shopping spree and spend a whopping $140! To make sure that their wives don't repeat their spree Ricky and Fred take the ladies on their next fishing trip.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes are cast in Little Ricky's school play when it runs short of cast members. Ricky plays a hollow tree, Lucy is the wicked witch, Fred plays the friendly frog, and Ethel is transformed in to the fairy princess.

Ricky insults Lucy's taste in hats so, as a joke, Lucy puts a loving cap trophy on her head that Ricky plans to present to champion jockey Johnny Longden at a National Turf Association dinner later that night. The trophy gets stuck on Lucy's head.

Little Ricky is turning 5 years old and Lucy had a party planned for Saturday, but Caroline Appleby is throwing a birthday party for her son Stevie on the same day. Neither mother is willing to change the date of their party.

Lucy and Ricky are determined to get rid of the puppy their son has brought home. They have a hard time overcoming Little Ricky’s arguments that it’s a welcome addition to a home that already boasts a parakeet, a frog, a lizard, a turtle and a goldfish.

programmes.st: Lucy Wants To Move To The Country
programmes.d: Lucy has become tired of living in the city and drops some none-too-subtle hints to Ricky that it would be nice to move to the country. Unbeknownst to her Ricky has already placed a comfortable deposit on a house in Westport, Connecticutt.

The Ricardos are anxious about their move to the country. Reality really sets in when Fred shows their apartment to a young couple. The Taylors will take the apartment but need to move in immediately.

The Ricardos get settled in their country home after all those years in a New York apartment and immediately begin to miss their old friends, Fred and Ethel. Lucy and Ricky decide to surprise the Mertzes with a visit.

programmes.st: Lucy Gets Chummy With The Neighbors
programmes.d: Wanting to replace their old furniture, Lucy gets an allowance of $500 from Ricky. Lucy goes overboard when she shops with their new neighbor Betty Ramsey, spending over three thousand dollars!

Although there are perks to living in their new country home, like House & Garden wanting to do a spread on them, the Ricardos find that it is expensive in Connecticut. Lucy decides to raise chickens and sell eggs as a moneymaking sideline.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, impatient with their egg selling business, decide that they must trade in their 500 chicks for 200 egg laying hens. However, after a couple of weeks, these hens don't yield many eggs at all.

Lucy decides to take part in the fund-raising campaign of the Westport Historical Society and offers to get her husband and his band to perform for their kickoff function. There's only one hitch – Ricky refuses to do it.

Lucy dreams of a night in New York City after spending six whole weeks in their new Connecticut home and it turns into a nightmare. Carefully hoarded tickets to a Broadway musical are supposed to take the Ricardos and the Mertzes to see the sold-out show.

Ethel is jealous of Lucy's friendship with neighbor Betty Ramsey. Sensitive to this, Lucy decides that the three of them should have a nice lunch together. Although reticent at first, Ethel opens up to Betty upon hearing they are both from Albuquerque.

Lucy must get vacationing Ricky out of her hair so she can do her housework. She and Ethel trick their husbands into building a brick barbecue on the Ricardo patio by first pretending to build it themselves.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes go with their neighbors, Ralph and Betty Ramsey, to the country club dance where a pretty visitor quickly convinces the men they are Romeos in disguise. They are each taken with Diana, the young beautiful cousin of a neighbor.

Suburbanite Lucy gets a green thumb and a competitive spirit. She has been raising tulips with a vengeance and wants to dethrone her neighbor Betty Ramsey for "Best Looking Garden" in the local garden club competition.

The town of Westport has commissioned a statue of a Minuteman to commemorate the Revolutionary War. The whole town is involved, from Fred who will serve as town crier to Ricky who will make the dedication speech.

programmes.st: The Girls Want to Go to A Nightclub
programmes.d: To celebrate the Mertzes' wedding anniversary, Fred and Ricky want to go to a prizefight, but the girls want to get dressed up and go to a nightclub. An argument ensues and Lucy threatens to find two other escorts if their husbands won't take them.

Lucy decides Ricky's love is growing cold so she takes Ethel's advice she learned from a book, How to Keep the Honeymoon from Ending. Her attempt to dress up for breakfast doesn't yield any response from Ricky.

One of the girls in Ricky's show quits, creating a vacancy which Lucy wants to fill. She goes down for an audition and can have the part provided she loses twelve ponds in four days to fit into the previous singer's size 12 outfit.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky Is Trying To Murder Her
programmes.d: Lucy is reading "The Mockingbird Murder Mystery" when Ethel reads her fortune and tells her death is near. Later she overhears a conversation between Ricky and his agent and she jumps to the wrong conclusion that he's trying to do away with her.
When Ricky cuts off Lucy's allowance and charge accounts because of her careless spending, Lucy finds herself short of funds. Ethel has tickets to a radio quiz show that has a cash prize of $1,000.
Network television scouts are going to check out Ricky's band and Lucy tries to "get into the act" in order to be discovered as well. Of course Ricky will not hear of it.
Lucy becomes interested in numerology and advises Ricky that it is a good day for him to make any deals he can. However, she soon realizes that she consulted the horoscope from yesterday's newspaper.
When Ricky leaves his clothes around the living room, Lucy gets angry and divides the room in half so Ricky can be as messy as he likes - on his side!

Ricky brings home a $3,500 mink coat to be used in his nightclub act, and Lucy assumes it's her anniversary present. Trying to get the coat away from her becomes a problem because Lucy not only wears it while she does housework, she even sleeps in it.
Ethel Mertz interprets a gossip column item to mean that Ricky is interested in one of the chorus girls in his nightclub. Ricky assures Lucy that it's just publicity.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky has Been Drafted
programmes.d: Lucy opens a telegram addressed to Ricky from the War Department ordering him to appear at the Army's Fort Dix. This letter plus the drills Ricky and Fred have been practicing in the living room convince the women that their husbands have been drafted.

The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.
