Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.
This gripping historical drama tells the true story of the Shanghai Rail Corps, a team of railroad workers turned secret resistance fighters during the Second Sino-Japanese war.

Feng shui master Kim Sang-deok joins a shaman and a mortician to relocate a cursed ancestral grave, but the excavation unearths a colonial atrocity buried beneath the soil, forcing crew into a brutal confrontation with an immortal warrior.

A priest and a skeptical young deacon try to save a girl who falls into a mysterious coma after a hit-and-run. Suspecting demonic possession, they perform an exorcism, but as they uncover the entity’s dark origins, they face a terrifying battle of faith and survival.

A young boy Hee-Joon is possessed by an evil spirit. Nun Yunia tries to save him, assisted by Nun Mikaela. Priest Paul attempts medical treatment, while Priest Andrew performs an exorcism to rid Hee-Joon of the spirit.
As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.
On a stormy night, a mysterious woman asks for shelter at Patrick's mobile home. Their anxiety and mutual mistrust grow as the night unfolds, causing fear and paranoia to engulf the small RV.
A young woman inherits a run-down pub and discovers a dark secret within its basement, Baghead, a shape-shifting creature that lets one speak to lost loved ones, but not without consequence.
A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.
Lillian and some friends travel back to the remote family cabin where her twin brother died the previous year. Soon, strange things start happening.
In a remote Irish village, police are called to the scene of a massacre, but they ignore the lone survivor's claim that the house was responsible for the carnage.
A teen links the mysterious disappearance of his sister to a supernatural game that's played in elevators.

Jonny Baptiste is sent to live with her estranged Aunt Hildie. On her 18th birthday, she experiences a family spell that redefines her, called Forevering. When several girls go missing at school, a feral Jonny hunts the perpetrator.
A sailing trip becomes a disaster for a group of friends when the boat sinks and a white shark hunts the helpless passengers.

Hoping to heal from a tragedy, a woman and her friends embark on a kayaking and diving adventure in tropical waters. However, the fun soon turns to terror when they find themselves fighting for their lives against a great white shark.
A woman's carefully constructed life gets upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.
After a night out, a couple are kidnapped by their black cab driver. Terrified, he drives them to a deserted and supposedly haunted road.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
A couple become trapped inside a hotel with their demons -- real and imagined -- until they can confront the secrets of their marriage.
An outsider seeks bloody vengeance against the sadistic cult leader who destroyed his peaceful existence.

As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!
The Homunculi are winning. Ed and Ling face a horrific enemy within the hellish expanse of Gluttony's gut. In Central, Mustang can only watch as his loyal band of soldiers is divided by Bradley.

Truths are exposed when Al finds the one called Father, and Mustang hears the tale of Bradley's creation - but the most amazing revelation is reserved for Ed after he once again breaks alchemy's greatest taboo.

Visions of the past play out by a warming fire as Hohenheim reflects on the unavoidable follies of man: the pain that comes with a loving family; the hidden truths of alchemy; and the roots and results of war.

As Chris spends his last day with Sonic while they prepare for their trip home, the President's army colonel decides to act on his own to capture Dr. Eggman.

Chris is unable to come to terms with the idea of parting with Sonic and decides to run away with Sonic. As the time runs short for Chaos Control to send Sonic back to his world before the two worlds merge, Chris and Sonic say their good byes one last time.

With everyone back in their home worlds the crisis has been averted, and all seems to be back to normal. Except, no one seems to know where Sonic is. His friends and even Eggman begin to wonder where he might be.

According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess. Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl name Alice who also wants the stamp tags along. A clever and very persistent Alice proves to be a major headache for Lupin. Will the little girl get her royal wish?

Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris. Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata. Inspector Garimard was the original Lupin's rival, and now their grandchildren are about to square off. Where will the chase lead the two rivals?

Lord En might be more interested in destroying his opponents at video games than destroying humanity, but his personal army, Behemoth's 34 Pillar Division, has other plans... So when one of the Pillars shows up and tries to make a blood contract with Kunieda, it's up to Oga and Hilda to rescue her.

Oga, frustrated with his loss to Behemoth's minions, decides he has to train to get stronger. But joining Kunieda's grandfather's dojo to train might not be the best idea…

A chameleonic genetic mutant which sucks out human emotions is loose aboard Red Dwarf.
Lister accidentally triggers the ship's self-destruct system.
The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.
Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.
Certain death at the hands of the simulants lead the Dwarfers to wonder if it's the end.
The Dwarfers find themselves in an alternative reality where technology is prohibited.
Lister and Cat get trapped when investigating a shipwreck at the bottom of an ocean moon.
After an altercation with a deranged droid, Lister has his kidneys organ-napped.
After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.
Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.
A radiation leak wipes out the crew of the ship Red Dwarf, leaving only one survivor.
Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.
Lister and Cat wake up with their legs in plaster. What's going on?
The crew of Red Dwarf have found a way to go back in time three million years.
Holly has been deposed and the back-up computer Queeg 500 is in control of Red Dwarf.
Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.

Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround h

In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to

Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they o

Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve

It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But

The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowe

With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insist

It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days e

The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeata

All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family pri

Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating

It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is

Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help

Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dra

In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.
The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.
After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his w

The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop�Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

After a brutal bank heist, two robbers die from snake bites before splitting the loot. Two years later, Pinkerton agent Jonathan Pinkerton arrives in Red Stone, hunting the missing third man and the stolen money. But as suspects pile up and corpses appear, he becomes the hunted - framed for the murders he’s trying to solve.

Misha y Kolia consiguen más tela con ayuda de Grigori, pero necesitan evitar levantar sospechas. Kolia obtiene una firma clave seduciendo a una secretaria. Mientras su negocio crece, un arresto inesperado pone en peligro toda la operación.

Mientras Kolia distrae a Ígor, Misha ayuda a Gena a escapar. Sin embargo, Galia es arrestada por fraude debido a Raisa. Misha intenta negociar su liberación sin éxito. Paralelamente, un trato con Ashot fracasa cuando la policía interviene, y Misha es secuestrado por un criminal llamado Boxeador.

Misha se enfrenta a Pan, un poderoso criminal, y negocia su vida y la de Galia a cambio de una alianza. Kolia intenta reunir dinero para ayudarlo, pero fracasa. Ahora, bajo el control de Pan, deben aumentar su producción de ropa, mientras Raisa confiesa sus crímenes y libera a Galia de los cargos.

Misha convence a Vasili de seguir colaborando tras revelarle la enfermedad de Pavlik. Galia regresa y sospecha que Misha la engaña. Mientras tanto, Pan ordena robar un tren con telas en lugar de comprarlas. Misha rechaza el robo y encuentra una alternativa con paracaídas de seda obsoletos.

Igor descubre que Gena es el proveedor de productos ilegales y lo entrega a la policía. Misha y Kolia pagan 30 mil para liberarlo, pero Gena es atropellado por Boxeador. Al mismo tiempo, Misha y Sima solicitan una visa para Israel, causando revuelo en su entorno, lo que lo obliga a renunciar a su trabajo.

Will Smith is a charming stranger who penetrates the world of a wealthy couple and alters their lives forever!
Jodie Foster makes her directorial debut and stars in this drama about a single mother and her son.
An rookie FBI agent goes up against a brutal serial killer...and a cannibalistic psychiatrist.
Hannibal Lecter comes out of hiding to draw Agent Clarice Starling into a high-stakes battle.
It's a battle to ensure the future of all mankind from The Terminator in this modern classic!
Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.
When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.
John Hurt shines as a doomed rebel in this stunning film adaptation of George Orwell's classic novel.
In this classic comedy, a teenager's life is improved when his werewolf nature bursts through!
When boozing Monty's mother-in-law leaves him an inheritance, he must change his ways before he can collect!
Wacky millionaire Thornton Melon enrolls in college...and higher education will never be the same again!
Our righteous heroes Bill and Ted discover their destiny in a time-travelling phone booth! Excellent!
The titular time travelers become history when they wind up face to face with the Grim Reaper!

Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.
Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.
Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.
Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!
Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programmes.t: To Live And Die In L.A.
programmes.d: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?
In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.
In the 1950s, an elite squad of detectives becomes embroiled in a conspiracy and faces a secret the U.S. government is determined to keep hidden.

Donald Sutherland stars in this moody thriller as a villainous Nazi spy whose passions betray him via a married woman (Kate Nelligan) in this intriguing blend of romance and espionage against the backdrop of WWII Britain.

Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.
On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!

Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!

To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programmes.t: The Monster That Challenged The World
programmes.d: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!
An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist’s twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programmes.t: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programmes.d: Panic is rampant in this acclaimed thriller about a band of space explorers who suddenly find themselves being hunted by a maniacal creature.
One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.
The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.

John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!

When a beautiful alien hybrid (Natasha Henstridge) escapes from his lab, a scientist (Ben Kingsley) hires a team of experts to find her before she is able to mate and produce offspring. It’s a desperate battle and the fate of humanity is at stake!

When an astronaut morphs into an alien entity, impregnating women with deadly results, a clone of Eve (Natasha Henstridge) is sent to hunt him down. But they underestimate Eve’s maternal drive…and now only the strongest species will survive!
Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!
When an evil troll attempts to forever erase mankind, a sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his plan.

Disguised as friendly country folk, a posse of people-eating trolls lures visitors to their town, and a family of four is about to discover this place is a real tourist trap. Now, the no-good gnomes must be destroyed before the family gets flambed.
When a physician accidentally swallows experimental bat serum pills, he finds himself saving patients by day…and sucking their blood by night!
Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!
It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood…until he finds a girl to share eternity with!
Dracula flees Europe and ends up in a small California town. And his ravenous thirst is quickly turning the Golden State into…the ghoulish state!
Dracula finds a victim with the perfect blood to resurrect his bloodsucking bride, but an error results in an unexpected change to his beloved.

In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.
Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.
Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programmes.t: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programmes.d: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

Charles Bronson gives a standout performance as an Apache on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer (Jack Palance). Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed deep into the Apache desert.

Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!
Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programmes.t: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programmes.d: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programmes.t: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programmes.d: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

Lisa Garr talks with Dr. Dain Heer, co-founder of Access Consciousness. Many of us suffer from a feeling of having to please others or conform to outside pressures. He shares his ideas on how to live authentically & his new book “Body Whispering.”

Lisa Garr talks with expert numerologist Glynis McCants. Known as “The Numbers Lady,” she talks about the history of Numerology as a numbers system and as a science used by Pythagoras forward. She explains about your life path & your personal year.

Your day 5 practice introduces principles of stability or Sthira. Though this practice we learn to to steady the mind as we strengthen the body. Build on yesterday’s practice to marry effort with ease. Invite your breath to be smooth and even as we continue to build on your foundation.

Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

1963 Playboy Icon and Cosby Survivor, Victoria Valentino, shares her journey of overcoming unimaginable circumstances leading her to activism and purpose. Plus, one man's heroic efforts to save a tiny, unconscious life, and fun street interviews from NYC.

Do you feel both captivated and exhausted by city life? Are the conveniences worth the chaos? In this episode of the Rooted in Wellness podcast, join me, Wade Lightheart, and Matt Gallant as we explore the challenges of maintaining balance in busy urban environments and the serene contrast of ashram life.
Have you wondered how to biohack your health as a woman? Taking control to live your best life is what we dive into in this episode with guest Aggie Lal.

If your mind feels foggy or unfocused, your food could be the missing piece. Mona unpacks how nutrition impacts your brain, mood, and energy—offering simple shifts to nourish your body and sharpen your mind from the inside out.

Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

If you get a brand new Toyota Camry, you can probably drive it for ten years without much attention. But if you have a 1938 Mercedes-Benz, it takes more love and care to keep it running. As we age, we become like that classic car, needing extra love and care.

Are there biomarkers we can measure that determine our biological age and the state of our operating system? How do we start to measure DNA methylation? What about our telomeres? En Flandes, Freddy Hernández y su esposa Edna también fueron víctimas de un proyecto sin permisos. Las autoridades investigan.

Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco sigue siendo un enigma. José Manuel Gnecco, principal sospechoso, insiste en su inocencia, mientras nuevas pruebas y la controversia sobre el arma homicida complican aún más el caso.

Ante la creciente delincuencia y la ineficacia policial, los ciudadanos recurren a la seguridad privada, la unión y vigilancia organizada surgen como respuesta urgente, evidenciando vacíos en la justicia y protección policial.
En Tame, Arauca, un militar fue condenado a 60 años por violar y asesinar brutalmente a tres niños. El Tribunal Superior de Bogotá lo encontró culpable de acceso carnal violento y homicidio agravado.

En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

Una historia de amor en Barranquilla termina en tragedia en Canadá. Patricia es asesinada por su esposo al descubrir infidelidad. Tras un juicio, él es condenado. Los hijos quedan al cuidado del hermano de Daniel.

En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

En 1993, Nancy Mestre, de 18 años, fue violada y asesinada por Jaime Saade Cormane tras salir con él en Nochevieja. Su padre, Martín, nunca se rindió: pasó 27 años investigando hasta descubrir que Saade había huido a Brasil bajo una nueva identidad. Gracias a su persistencia, fue capturado en 2020, aunque la extradición a Colombia sigue pendiente.

Carmenza López exige respuestas sobre el asesinato de su esposo Guillermo Leal, edil de Sumapaz secuestrado por las FARC en 2008. Aunque recibió un cuerpo, ella duda que fueran sus restos. Trece años después, sigue buscando la verdad, ahora como miembro de la Mesa de víctimas de Sumapaz, enfrentando a los desmovilizados sin darles el perdón que aún no siente merecido.

Estos invitados dicen que están seguros de saber quién es el padre de sus hijos, pero necesitan una prueba de ADN para comprobarlo. Ahora los resultados están a punto de descubrirse, pero ¿serán los resultados que esperaban?

El año pasado, Maurice fue descubierto engañando a Karen en The Maury Show y ha vuelto con su nueva prometida, Shauntia. ¿Sigue siendo infiel? Entonces, Destanee, de 17 años, cree que el padre de su bebé la engaña... ¡con su madre!

¡Estas mujeres han venido con preguntas urgentes! Kendra quiere que su esposo Richard admita que es el padre de su hijo Y del hijo de su amante! ¡Jevon y su familia no creen que él sea el padre del hijo de Jazmine! ¡Solo MAURY tiene las respuestas!

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, time is critical as Dr Scott Taylor’s unresponsive patient deteriorates with a suspected brain bleed. Dr Tristan Harding must straighten a young man’s dislocated ankle before the blood supply cuts off.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Drs Michael Dunne and Jonathan Papson urgently need answers for one of the sickest patients they’ve seen. Dr Michelle Thornhill examines a teenager in agony after he fell onto back while riding a dirt bike.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, doctors Tinnie Chang and Caitlin Young fear a cyclist has life-changing injuries. Dr Emma West suspects a happy man is hiding his injuries after a motorbike crash, but scans don’t lie.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Jonathan Papson struggles to cut a glove from a construction worker’s mangled hand. Dr Assiya Halid examines the shocking injuries of a driver who smashed his lovingly-restored car into a wall.

At The Royal Melbourne Doctor Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr James Williams fears for a young cheerleader who’s landed on her head in training. Dr Michael Dunne expects the worst when he unwraps the bandages from a man’s arm after it was mangled in a car accident.

Dr David Sparkhall fears the worst as he takes the tourniquet off a handyman’s blood-soaked arm. Dr Tristan Harding expects multiple injuries in a man who’s fallen off a roof-top balcony. Dr Emma West calms a mum who’s cut though her hand.

Dr Tinnie Chang’s confused patient has severe head and back injuries after a horror fall. Nurse Lucy Stranger and Dr Zaheer Jayhoon fear the worst for a woman with heart issues. Dr Bec Hughes’ young patient has strange abdominal pain.
A rider is bucked off her horse and is lying helpless in remote bushland. A risky chopper rescue is her only chance, and Bill desperately tries to save a teacher having a massive heart attack.

Paramedics Laura and Aaron prepare for double the complications when a pregnant mum goes into labour. In a first for the show, cameras follow the patient into hospital not to save a life, but to welcome a new one.

Ben and Mim find a grandfather in agony with horrific burns after spilling a huge pot of boiling water over himself. Lisa’s first day back from maternity leave has her examining a tiny baby with a soaring heart rate and high temperature.

Aaron and Laura fear the worst as they rush to a teen victim of a shark bite. Ben and Mim must tackle a footy player who’s dislocated his shoulder and super mums, Sally and Olivia race to a terrified one year old with a severed finger.

Every second counts as paramedics rush to help people in crisis. A leaking oxygen bottle blows up in a man’s face. Nhi and Carlos fear he could stop breathing at any moment. Bill is on high alert, dealing with a violent knife fight.
Aaron and Laura desperately try to stop blood pouring from a pedestrian’s head after he was hit by a car and terrifying seizures threaten to leave a young Mum with permanent brain damage.

Aaron and Laura rush to a young mother who is bleeding heavily from cervical cancer and a bizarre case for Lisa as she is called to a patient whose obsession with hot chillies has now left him in excruciating pain
Ben and Mim are called to a patient in the final stages of labour. Newly qualified Ben has never delivered a baby and he’s hoping this will be his first. A dementia case hits home for Lisa.
A hero bystander uses CPR to bring a woman back from the dead but intensive care paramedic Bill needs to get the grandmother to hospital before she goes back into a fatal cardiac arrest.

Paramedics, Sally and Olivia fear the worst for a young motorcyclist in agonising pain after a terrifying accident and Laura and Aaron are impressed by the courage of a little boy who has suffered an horrendous fractured leg.

Dr Emma faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, yet he’s putting up a fight. Dr Mark treats a factory worker in shock after being confronted with horrific life-changing injuries.

A gunshot victim arrives under police guard and Dr Sarah fears the patient could die from his injuries. Dr Jonathan treats a critical footy player after an on-field collision. Nurse Lucy worries a pregnant patient can’t feel her baby move.

Dr Mark tries to help a car crash patient under police guard, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse.

Dr Mark assembles a crack team to save a man with life-threatening gunshot wounds. Dr Jonathan suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career.

Dr Emma’s patient could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael on high alert. Dr Michelle stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

Security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto hospital staff. Dr Jonathan’s car crash patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt, but she’s more worried what her dad will say. Dr Mya’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed.

Dr Steve’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking accident at an abattoir. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn suspects another trigger. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana.

A life hangs in the balance as Dr Emma rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Dr Lauren treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff and is bleeding heavily from an open fracture.

Dr Miriam treats a heavily pregnant mum-to-be who collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Sarah fears for a cyclist who was hit by a car and can’t feel his feet.

Mark and Carina race to help a critically injured paraglider who’s crashed into a cliff. A creepy case of bed bugs makes Michelle nervous. Jamie and Mike struggle to convince a cyclist hit by a car that she needs to go to hospital.

Mark and Carina race to save a young woman struggling to breathe from a severe asthma attack. Matt airlifts a trauma patient to hospital after a horror car crash. Taz and Amanda find a fun way of deciding who drives the ambulance.

Nat and Leonard get a surprise while treating a suspected drug overdose. A heartbreaking fall for a 98-year-old woman requires a delicate rescue mission. And vicious abuse from a member of the public shocks Amanda and Taz.

Nat and Leonard battle to save an elderly woman after a suspected stroke. Taz and Amanda race to help a child trapped in a car outside a kindergarten. A missing item of clothing has Nicola and Michelle scratching their heads.

Matt treats a patient burnt in a work-place explosion, but bad weather jeopardises the flight to hospital. Nat presses Leonard to propose marriage. Mark struggles with a misbehaving driver who’s crashed into a pole.

Mark is called to a volatile emergency as a man leaps from a moving car and goes on a rampage. Flight paramedic Ray races to a camping trip SOS. Amanda and Leonard treat a badly injured tourist after an ill-fated skateboarding attempt.

Every second counts as paramedics try to reach an unconscious patient by breaking into her house. Mark and Carina treat a man with a life-threatening condition, where the only way to save him is to stop his heart.

A mysterious young woman found unresponsive on a bus has Carina baffled. Matt becomes concerned after a frightened car crash survivor loses her memory. Risky and Nicola are confronted by an unwanted intruder.

Mark races to help a young father in danger of losing his arm, following a horrific workplace accident. After a car crash leaves a trail of destruction creating chaos, Nat and Leonard are shocked by a patient’s surprising revelation.

Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a man who’s been on a two-day drug bender. Dr Emma calls in back-up to save a mum who’s clinging to life after a high-speed crash.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, a teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. This potentially career-ending injury isn’t Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing rings from swollen fingers.

At Royal Melbourne emergency, an abattoir worker has cut her fingers off. Can Dr Bjorn Makein and nurse Sarah Thomas save her hand? Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

A crane operator is crushed under falling steel at work and is flown to The Royal Melbourne. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats an erratic pregnant woman.

At Royal Melbourne Emergency a paramedic becomes the patient after stepping on a deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse and trampled.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Sarah Whitelaw battles to save a teen driver with major head injuries after rolling his car. A trail bike rider crashes horribly, but impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his wit.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, doctors rush to save a man bleeding internally after being thrown from a horse. A law student’s condition puzzles Dr Luke. Dr George has grave fears for a handy man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from a backyard hive.

Every second counts at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, as injured people pour in. Dr Luke treats an injured tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks!

Australia’s paramedics fight to save lives in a race against time. Mike and Eamon treat the teenage victim of a brutal assault. Ray and the Air Ambulance crew help an unlucky gardener with a bizarre and dangerous injury.

A shocking motorcycle accident leaves a family man in critical condition. Can surgery in the back of an ambulance keep him alive? Cam races to help a baby arriving in a hurry. Amanda and Taz help a little patient who’s had a big fall.
